preconditions.description: The number of employees must be between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 9 and 1 <= bi <= 9 and ai != bi for ai, bi in employees)
preconditions.description: Each employee's starting and destination floors must be between 1 and 9, and they must be different.
The number of employee entries must match the specified number of employees.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimal time in seconds required to deliver all employees to their destinations.
